# Bundled browser libraries

- fflate 0.8.2, MIT: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
- PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 3.11.174, Apache-2.0: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

The corresponding license files are included here. PDF.js is loaded only for PDF skin artwork, with isEvalSupported=false. All files are bundled locally and included in the offline cache.
